back.target: to hit (a target), to strike (of a shot, ball or blow reaching its mark)
back.example: The ball hit me on the head.

note: The hint "a target" is what separates this card from schlagen and from the "to meet" card, so keep it. The Spanish cards golpear-hit and pegar-hit mean striking a blow, not reaching a target, so sameAs is rightly null.
